title: Launch Runbox — daily scratchpad
content:
2026-03-13 (Friday) — launch runbox / quick capture

Top objective: unblock staging smoke, finalize PRD edits, confirm rollout windows, and short rollback plan. Keep this file noisy — toss quick captures then refine for Confluence later.

MORNING TRIAGE (8:30–10:00)
- 08:30: sync w/ Avery (infra) — staging GPU pool hitting OOM during long generation test. Action: narrow max_tokens to 1024 for smoke, enable kv-cache size cap.
- 09:00: quick call w/ Miguel (SRE) — agreed to add temporary autoscale threshold (cpu>75% for 30s) and a manual burst lane to Dedicated for first 2 hours. Miguel to open JIRA.
- 09:30: pinged legal (Priya) for dataplane checklist — received ack on KMS usage but need final audit export by EOD.

PRD EDITS (INLINE) — items to finish before handing to writing team
- Clarify fallback model policy (section 2.3): fallback should be the quantized variant v1.8-quant unless latency > 400ms, then route to hosted-small. (TODO: write precise routing rule syntax)
- Add explicit SLO failure modes: token-error-rate >0.5% triggers rollback. Need wording for 'user-visible' vs 'system-only' errors.
- Update metrics table: add per-request cache-hit, avg-batch-size, and 95th-token-latency. Miguel to confirm metric names in Prometheus.
- Remove the long note about future multi-tenant pooling — move to roadmap appendix.

STAKEHOLDER FOLLOW-UPS
- PM: send short digest to eng leads by 11:30 (I) — include ETA for PRD final and canary plan.
- Growth: ask for copy snippets for onboarding flow (Kiara) — high priority, pinged in Slack, awaiting reply.
- Support: share runbook with Level1 for flagged errors (ticket template) — need acceptance by 15:00.

LAUNCH CHECKLIST (shallow -> deep)
- [x] Canary image built: docker image tag launch-2026-03-13-rc1
- [x] Basic smoke tests: token-gen, embeddings, tool-calls passed on small seq length
- [ ] Staging stress: 30m sustained load at 2x expected QPS (blocked by OOM)
- [ ] Observability: dashboards wired to console (cost by token, tail latency, error types) (Avery/Miguel)
- [ ] Rollout policy: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 2 hours with automatic rollback on token-error spike (need rule syntax)
- [ ] Customer notices: draft created, needs legal sign-off (Priya)
- [ ] Post-launch smoke: run smoke suite and verify no >1% regression in quality metrics (eval harness)

ROLLBACK / FALLOVER NOTES (keep short)
- If 95th-token-latency > 800ms for >5m -> trigger automatic fallback to hosted-small and alert SRE.
- If token-error-rate >0.5% for >3m -> rollback canary and notify product/sre/eng leads.
- Manual actions: contact Miguel -> promote burst capacity, contact Avery -> revert model version.

KNOWN RISKS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Will quantized fallback preserve hallucination profile? Need quick eval run on PRD prompt set. (Action: schedule 15-min eval, Miguel + Research)
- Cost delta: Dedicated burst lane pricing unknown for first-hour usage. Finance contact? (Action: loop in Sam from finance)
- Legal wants proof of KMS rotations; how quickly can audit export be produced? Priya says EOD might be tight.

TIMED TASKS (TODAY)
- 10:30: finalize PRD changes -> push to /confluence/PRD-launch (I)
- 11:15: send digest to eng leads (I)
- 12:30: lunch (no screens ideally)
- 13:30: re-check staging stress after patch (Avery)
- 15:00: accept L1 runbook and close support ticket (Support)
- 16:30: prep canary schedule + Slack blast copy (I)
- 17:30: final go/no-go short call (15m)

NOTES TO SELF / QUICK IDEAS
- Keep fallback variants as explicit artifacts in repo so infra can route by tag rather than 'name match' (helps auditability).
- Could add a tiny synthetic eval that runs during canary to detect hallucination spikes — cheap (100 prompts) and good signal.
- Postmortem template: capture timeline, metric deltas (cost/latency/quality), triage notes, action items with owners.

SNIPPETS / LINKS TO PASTE INTO CONFLUENCE LATER
- Routing rule draft (copy): if latency>400ms AND model_variant==vX -> route to vX-quant OR hosted-small; if token_error_rate>0.5% -> rollback.
- Short digest blurb: "Rolling out model v2026-03-13-rc1 to hosted API. Canary starts 14:00 PST, automated rollback on error-rate or latency regressions. Primary contacts: Riley, Miguel, Avery."

END NOTES: noisy, will prune after 17:30 call. Keep this as ground truth of decisions and todo items.
summary: Personal PM scratchpad for launch day: triage, PRD edits, stakeholder follow-ups, checklist, rollback plan, risks, timed tasks.
